input: made ai resume builder project using react django gemini api and latex where user enters rough points and ai converts them into resume bullets and pdf is generated

output.title: AI-Powered Resume Builder
output.summary: A full-stack web application that leverages generative AI to transform rough user inputs into polished resume bullets and generate downloadable PDFs.
bullets: Developed a full-stack web application utilizing React for a responsive user interface and Django for robust backend API management.
Integrated the Gemini API to process informal, rough user inputs and dynamically generate polished, professional resume bullet points.
Implemented a LaTeX compilation pipeline to automatically format the AI-generated content and generate downloadable, high-quality PDF resumes.
